notes.title: New BIG update coming soon...!
notes.content:
A new update is coming! Many new things will be added:
- More car parts
- Better heating
- Moving the camera in the car
- radio!
- reworked map
- Story!
- AND MANY MANY MORE!

The update will be released at the end of July, plans to release the full game in the fall!

notes.title: Update 0.2v - New patch
notes.content:
Has been fixed:
[list]

[/list]

The next updates will bring new features in the game!
